_classification: SECURITY_CRITICAL — assurance assignment registry; governs which property is proven for every SECURITY collection. Governed by review-pin (its own digest) -> review-record ledger.

justifications.bootstrap_operator::iam:CreatePolicy: creates the reviewed boundary policy ONCE; holds no version/delete capability so cannot revise the ceiling
justifications.bootstrap_operator::iam:DeleteRolePermis: rollback path; Gate 4N-I10 removed the condition so an unpopulated key cannot deaden rollback
justifications.bootstrap_operator::iam:PutRolePermissio: its only job; conditioned on iam:PermissionsBoundary == the reviewed boundary so cannot attach a permissive one
justifications.boundary::ecs:RunTask: the revision-reader runner's only job is to run exactly one task definition family
justifications.boundary::iam:PassRole: the runner passes exactly the reader execution role
justifications.boundary::kms:Decrypt: the same roles decrypt those secrets under the SECRETS CMK; STATE CMK stays denied
justifications.boundary::s3:GetObject: api/worker task roles read the application bucket
justifications.boundary::secretsmanager:GetSecretValue: ecs-execution/reader-execution roles read the secrets their task defs reference; blanket deny breaks startup (in_scope bounds to those roles)
justifications.role_bootstrap_operator::iam:CreateRole: creating exactly the three reader roles is its only purpose; trust bytes controlled by read-back not IAM
justifications.role_bootstrap_operator::iam:DeleteRole: reverts a role whose trust document fails read-back; detect-without-revert is an alert not a control
justifications.temporary_operator::dynamodb:DeleteItem: releases the state lock it acquired
justifications.temporary_operator::dynamodb:GetItem: inspects the state lock before acquiring it
justifications.temporary_operator::iam:PutRolePolicy: writes the inline policies the composition declares for its own roles; Gate 4N-I16 Defect 3 REQUIRED_TEMPORARILY
justifications.temporary_operator::kms:Decrypt: decrypts the state object under the STATE CMK (SECRETS CMK stays fenced off by in_scope predicate)
justifications.temporary_operator::s3:GetObject: reads the encrypted state object; state_backend_closure.read
justifications.temporary_operator::s3:PutObject: writes the new Terraform state object on apply; state_backend_closure.write_apply_only

justifications.sts:GetCallerIdentity: returns only the caller's own identity, touches no resource and grants no access, so a '*' resource is meaningless/safe; the comment notes it is 'not a wildcard; listed for symmetry with the audit output'

check_toolchain_integrity.py::FORBIDDEN_.positive_control: set each FORBIDDEN_ENV var (e.g. AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE=/tmp/evil) in the toolchain env and assert check_toolchain_integrity aborts/neutralizes before any provider/state operation; a pass-through fails closed
set a var under each prefix (e.g. TF_CLI_ARGS_apply=-auto-approve, TF_VAR_x=y) and assert the integrity check aborts/neutralizes; pass-through fails closed

deny_requirements.py::ARCHITECTURE_INVAR.positive_control: drop/weaken any required deny row (e.g. remove iam:PassRole from permanent_w0_must_not_mutate_iam in the generated policy) and assert deny_triangulation reports MISSING/CONFLICTING_SCOPE/IMPLICIT_DENY for it, failing closed

deny_requirements.py::AWS_SERVICE_SAFETY.positive_control: for a denied action, grant one of its listed siblings in the generated policy (e.g. add dynamodb:BatchWriteItem where PutItem is denied) and assert triangulation flags the equivalent path, failing closed

justifications.__dict__: the namespace container itself; its members are digested individually, digesting the container would be circular
justifications.__doc__: module docstring, inert text carrying no security state
justifications.__file__: loader-supplied path metadata, not executed program state
justifications.__loader__: import machinery loader object, not executed state
justifications.__name__: import-system module identity, not executed state
justifications.__spec__: import machinery ModuleSpec metadata, not executed state

justifications.cache_authority::_PINS: runtime memoisation registry populated from the authoritative pins; the pins themselves are digested at source
justifications.docker_assurance_state::_STATE_CACHE: lazily-populated per-run docker assurance memo cache, recomputed from disk state each run
justifications.site_taxonomy::_DERIVED,_INDEX: lazily-built derived taxonomy index/cache rebuilt from pinned source data on demand; not an independent authority

external_executable_trust.py::FATAL_STEE.positive_control: invoke the trusted-executable boundary with e.g. GIT_EXTERNAL_DIFF=/tmp/evil or BASH_ENV=/tmp/evil set and assert it aborts (fail-closed) before running the external tool

external_executable_trust.py::NEUTRALIZE.positive_control: set e.g. GIT_SSH_COMMAND=/tmp/evil or GIT_ASKPASS=/tmp/evil, run the boundary, and assert the child git process does NOT see the attacker value (env is neutralized); leakage fails closed

justifications.iam:CreatePolicy: required to create the reviewed boundary policy exactly once; no version/delete capability accompanies it, so the ceiling cannot be revised
justifications.iam:DeleteRolePermissionsBoundary: the reviewed rollback path for a mis-attached boundary
justifications.iam:PutRolePermissionsBoundary: the operator's sole purpose; conditioned on the reviewed boundary ARN so it cannot attach a permissive boundary

justifications.iam:CreateRole: forbidden-but-excepted: creating exactly the three reader roles is its only job; trust bytes gated by read-back
justifications.iam:DeleteRole: forbidden-but-excepted: reverts a role that fails trust read-back (revert, not just alert)
justifications.iam:TagRole: NOTE not present in FORBIDDEN_CAPABILITIES, so this is a harmless (no-op) over-exception, not a security gap; justified as tagging the created roles for inventory

justifications..mypy_cache: generated mypy cache, no authored source
justifications..pytest_cache: generated pytest cache, no authored source
justifications..terraform: downloaded provider/module cache, not authored source
justifications.__pycache__: compiled bytecode cache, derived from scanned source
justifications.node_modules: third-party installed dependencies, not first-party source
justifications.vendor: vendored third-party dependencies, not first-party source

justifications..git: VCS internal object store, not authored source

policy_inventory.py::NOT_A_POLICY.positive_control: add a genuine policy identifier to NOT_A_POLICY and assert the policy inventory still subjects that policy to its authority/enforcement checks (i.e. exclusion cannot suppress a real policy); if it escapes, fail closed

production_certification.py::SELF_ATTEST.positive_control: submit a certification candidate whose only evidence for a check lives in a self-attesting field (e.g. expected_sha256 asserting its own hash with no independent recompute) and assert production_certification refuses to certify / fails closed

protected_inventory.py::SELF_ATTESTING_F.positive_control: present a protected-inventory record whose sha256/digest is self-declared but does not match an independent recompute, and assert protected_inventory flags a mismatch rather than trusting the self-attested field

provenance.py::NON_CERTIFYING.positive_control: offer a certification whose provenance is e.g. CI_EQUIVALENT_LOCAL_REPRODUCTION or INFERRED and assert certifies_production stays false / the gate refuses, failing closed

pytest_config_contract.py::COLLECTION_RE.positive_control: introduce a collection-removing mechanism (e.g. a conftest defining one of these, or a novel remover) that drops a security test, and assert the config contract detects the shrunken collection / rejects the deselection, failing closed

role_bootstrap_lifecycle.py::IDENTITY_CE.positive_control: construct a lifecycle step whose action is an Identity-Center admin action but owner != ROOT and assert the lifecycle rejects it; a non-ROOT-owned admin action passing fails closed

justifications.__class__: universal object type introspection, present on every object, carries no execution capability by itself
justifications.__dict__: namespace-mapping introspection, not an executable call site

justifications.-review.txt: human-authored free-text review notes, not a checksummed/manifest-bound build artifact
justifications.-verdict.txt: human-authored verdict note, not a checksummed/manifest-bound build artifact

workflow_assurance.py::_MUTABLE_TAG_TOKE.positive_control: feed a workflow reference tagged with a mutable token (e.g. image:latest / @main) and assert workflow_assurance rejects it as non-immutable; acceptance fails closed
